verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a public REST API v2 with resource-oriented URLs. It supports personal access tokens and OAuth with scopes, covers booking and reading/writing scheduling data, and offers a Scheduling API pattern for AI agents. It is available on all plans, including Free, and is backed by agent-friendly llms.txt/Markdown docs and a reference that maps MCP tools to REST endpoints. Missing for 10: strong independent hands-on corroboration of API depth and reliability (the only community signal is a brief mention of building an integration on Calendly).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Calendly API v2 is REST-based and has predictable resource-oriented URLs.
Programmatically book meetings and read and write Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker data.
Developers can make GET and POST requests to API endpoints on behalf of a Calendly user on any subscription plan, including the Free plan
Enable AI assistants or agents in your product to book meetings end‑to‑end via Calendly's Scheduling API endpoint.
Scopes control which Calendly resources your integration can read or modify.
